cover.headline_html: 3 myths that stop small businesses cold.

myths.label: The Past Performance Barrier
myths.myth_text: You need past performance on a government contract before you can get a GSA Schedule.
myths.reality_text: GSA MAS has no past performance requirement. You need 2 years in business and $25K in prior commercial revenue. That's it. Most small businesses already qualify.

myths.label: The Lowest Price Trap
myths.myth_text: Your GSA prices have to be lower than anything else you offer.
myths.reality_text: GSA pricing is based on your Basis of Award — your most-favored commercial customer rate. You're not undercutting your whole market. You're matching your best deal.

myths.label: The Passive Revenue Myth
myths.myth_text: Once you have a GSA Schedule, agencies search the catalog and contracts start coming in.
myths.reality_text: The Schedule opens the door. It does not knock for you. You still need to respond to RFQs, build CO relationships, and actively market your contract vehicle.

close.close_question: Drop the belief about GovCon that you held the longest — and what finally changed your mind.
